form.title: Connect HugeGraph
form.subtitle: Provide your HugeGraph REST host, ports, and graph name to get started.

methods.label: REST API (Gremlin over HTTP)
methods.description: Enter your HugeGraph server host, the REST and Gremlin ports, and the name of the graph instance to query. Works with any self-hosted Apache HugeGraph deployment.
methods.how_to:
## Connect via the HugeGraph REST API

HugeGraph exposes two HTTP endpoints you'll use:

- **REST API** (default port `18088`) — for graph management and schema/data operations: `GET /graphs`, `/graphs/{graph}/schema/*`, `POST /graphs/{graph}/graph/vertices`, `POST /graphs/{graph}/graph/edges`.
- **Gremlin Server over REST** (default port `18182` — a *separate* port from the REST API) — for running Gremlin queries: `POST {host}:{gremlin_port}/gremlin` with body `{"gremlin": "<script>"}`. Responses come back as `{"status": {"code": 200}, "result": {"data": ...}}`.

### Steps

1. Enter the **Host** — hostname or IP of your HugeGraph server (e.g. `10.36.28.2` or `127.0.0.1`).
2. Keep the default ports unless your deployment differs: REST `18088`, Gremlin `18182`. In a standard docker-compose / Helm deployment these are separate services on separate ports.
3. Enter the **Graph** name — the HugeGraph instance to query (e.g. `hugegraph`). This is used in `/graphs/{name}` paths and, importantly, as the Gremlin binding name: every script must start with `def g = this.binding.getAt("DEFAULT-{graph}").traversal();` before using `g.V()`, `g.E()`, etc.
4. Optionally set **Hubble Port** (`18085`) for the Hubble web UI and **Vermeer Port** (`18688`) for the Vermeer analytics service (healthcheck: `GET {host}:{vermeer_port}/api/v1/healthcheck`, where `errcode` 0 means healthy).

### Notes

- Most self-hosted deployments run with open REST access (no auth). If your deployment has authentication enabled, note it here and Anton will adapt.
- A quick way to verify the graph name: `GET {host}:{rest_port}/graphs` returns a JSON list of configured graphs.

fields.name: host
fields.label: Host
fields.description: Hostname or IP address of your HugeGraph server.

fields.name: rest_port
fields.label: REST Port
fields.description: HugeGraph REST API port. Default is 18088.

fields.name: gremlin_port
fields.label: Gremlin Port
fields.description: Gremlin Server (over REST) port. Default is 18182 — separate from the REST API port in standard deployments.

fields.name: graph
fields.label: Graph
fields.description: Name of the HugeGraph instance to query. Used in /graphs/{name} paths and as the Gremlin binding DEFAULT-{name}.

fields.name: hubble_port
fields.label: Hubble Port (optional)
fields.description: Port of the Hubble web UI, if deployed. Default is 18085.

fields.name: vermeer_port
fields.label: Vermeer Port (optional)
fields.description: Port of the Vermeer analytics service, if deployed. Healthcheck: GET /api/v1/healthcheck (errcode 0 = ok). Default is 18688.
